The prior of a volatility break

Source: R/volatility_break.R
volatility_break_prior.Rd

Checks sigma$volatility against the model and returns the prior a volatility break is drawn under, or NULL for a model without one.

Usage

volatility_break_prior(object, sigma)

Arguments

object

a model object whose model$volatility_break says whether it has a break.

sigma

the list given to add_priors, whose element volatility is the prior: shape, the Pareto shape of every free scale, and rho_shape1 and rho_shape2, the two shapes of the beta prior on the rate the excess decays at.

Value

A named list of the prior, or NULL.

Details

Exported for the same reason as check_volatility_break: a package that builds its own models checks the prior the same way. There is no default, as there is none for the rest of sigma, and the message names the values of Lenza and Primiceri (2022). A prior given to a model without a break is refused rather than ignored, and a break without a prior is refused as well.

See also

check_volatility_break
